'''2007 Georgia State Championship Jeff Anderson LS Rebel Strike Team''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jeff Anderson]] at [[2007 Georgia State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Endor-L-rebelstriketeam.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Boom Race
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
